actions.text: Committee on Indian Affairs. Hearings held.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Indian Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the members and governance of the Poarch Band of Creek Indians.
dimensions.evidence: The Poarch Band of Creek Indians shall be considered 'now under Federal jurisdiction' as of June 18, 1934

dimensions.assessment: Resolves legal status following the Carcieri v. Salazar Supreme Court decision, securing trust land status and federal statutory eligibility for the tribe.
dimensions.evidence: All lands taken into trust by the United States for the benefit of the Poarch Band of Creek Indians... are reaffirmed as trust land

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal appropriations or spending authorizations are mentioned in the text.
Applies a specific federal statute (the Indian Reorganization Act) to one tribe and ratifies prior administrative trust land actions.
dimensions.evidence: To reaffirm the applicability of the Indian Reorganization Act to the Poarch Band of Creek Indians, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory status determination and land trust reaffirmation.
dimensions.evidence: All lands taken into trust... are reaffirmed as trust land, and the actions of the Secretary... are ratified and confirmed.

missing_information: Total acreage and economic value of the lands reaffirmed into trust.
importance_detail.rationale: Applies the Indian Reorganization Act to the Poarch Band of Creek Indians by deeming them under federal jurisdiction as of June 18, 1934, and reaffirms all prior land-into-trust decisions made by the Department of the Interior for the tribe.
